title: NYC Bungee
description:
In this breathtakingly beautiful experience, players will get the opportunity to bungee jump from one of the world’s most iconic landmarks. Take the elevator right to the famous torch of the Statue of Liberty before soaking up the scenery and finally jumping off in this dare devil challenge which is certainly not for the faint of heart! Those in search of a tranquil session can ride a hot air balloon high above the Hudson river, whilst those seeking a more energetic route can climb to the crown as we get to experience the Big Apple like never before.

Watch as planes, balloons and birds soar across the New York City skyline and take in a view that very few people will ever get to see in this painstakingly detailed experience.

Bungee Jump from the world famous Statue Of Liberty

The ultimate test of courage! Have you got the guts to jump from the Statue of Liberty?

Climb Lady Liberty

In a race to the top with a global leaderboard. Unleash your inner Spider-Man and experience Lady Liberty like never before!

Float to new heights in a Hot Air Balloon

See New York as never before in the most relaxing part of our experience. Float away and forget your troubles
